Perivascular epithelioid cell neoplasms arising within the retroperitoneal autonomic ganglia remain poorly characterized at the transcriptomic level. Between March 2014 and November 2021, we analyzed formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded specimens from 19 patients treated at Tartu University Hospital and Rigshospitalet Copenhagen. Whole-exome sequencing identified recurrent truncating mutations in TSC2 in 14 tumors, whereas 3 cases harbored a previously unreported SFPQ-TFE3 exon 7-4 fusion transcript confirmed by fluorescence in situ hybridization. Immunohistochemical staining for cathepsin K and HMB-45 demonstrated diffuse cytoplasmic positivity in 17 of 19 lesions, while SOX10 and synaptophysin were uniformly negative. Across a median follow-up of 46 months, patients receiving adjuvant nab-sirolimus at 75 mg/m2 achieved a 3-year progression-free survival rate of 78.4% compared with 41.2% among historical controls managed by surgical resection alone (log-rank p = 0.0083).

Subclinical right ventricular longitudinal strain impairment often precedes overt decompensation in adults with repaired tetralogy of Fallot and moderate pulmonary regurgitation. In a prospective two-center cohort at Kepler University Hospital Linz and the Thoraxcenter Rotterdam, 134 ambulatory patients (mean age 31.7 years, 58% male) underwent simultaneous 4D flow cardiovascular magnetic resonance and speckle-tracking echocardiography at baseline and 24 months. Free-wall longitudinal strain worse than -16.8% combined with a plasma hepatocyte growth factor concentration above 490 pg/mL predicted sustained atrial tachyarrhythmias or right ventricular outflow tract reintervention with a hazard ratio of 4.37 (95% CI 2.14-8.91, p = 0.00018). Kinetic energy dissipation within the infundibular recess correlated inversely with peak oxygen uptake on cardiopulmonary exercise testing (Spearman rho = -0.54, p < 0.001).

Resistance to third-generation cephalosporins among bloodstream isolates of Klebsiella variicola has increased across tertiary neonatal intensive care units in southern Brazil. We characterized 67 non-duplicate isolates recovered from neonates in Porto Alegre and Florianopolis between January 2019 and August 2023 using Oxford Nanopore long-read sequencing and broth microdilution susceptibility testing. Forty-two isolates carried an IncFII(K) conjugative plasmid of 118.6 kb encoding blaCTX-M-15 alongside the tellurite resistance operon terZABCDE and the iron acquisition locus kfuABC. In Galleria mellonella larval infection assays, strains harboring the hypermucoviscous rmpA2 frameshift allele exhibited a 72-hour survival rate of 14.0% versus 61.5% for capsule-deficient isogenic mutants (p = 0.0004). Ceftazidime-avibactam retained 100% in vitro activity with an MIC90 of 0.25 mg/L.

Allosteric inhibition of the mitochondrial NADP+-dependent isocitrate dehydrogenase IDH2 represents a selective vulnerability in therapy-induced senescent glioblastoma stem-like cells. Using a high-throughput thermal shift screen of 14,800 macrocyclic peptidomimetics, we identified compound KRX-4091, which binds an interfacial pocket adjacent to Arg172 with a dissociation constant of 38 nM by isothermal titration calorimetry. In patient-derived neurosphere lines GBM-74B and U3047MG pre-exposed to 6 Gy fractionated irradiation, 250 nM KRX-4091 depleted intramitochondrial NADPH by 68%, suppressed glutathione reductase recycling, and triggered ferroptotic lipid peroxidation preventable by liproxstatin-1. Orthotopic xenografts in athymic nude mice treated orally with 30 mg/kg KRX-4091 twice daily showed a median survival extension from 34 to 59 days (p = 0.0006) without hematopoietic toxicity.

Chronic occupational exposure to vanadium pentoxide dust among boilermakers has been linked to small-airway remodeling, yet early urinary biomarkers of bronchiolar club cell injury remain unvalidated. We enrolled 218 maintenance workers at two oil-fired power stations in Tarragona and Brindisi over three consecutive annual turnaround cycles. Personal cascade impactor sampling recorded a geometric mean respirable vanadium concentration of 18.4 ug/m3 during furnace deslagging shifts. Post-shift serum club cell secretory protein CC16 declined by 23.6% (95% CI 17.9-29.3%), while urinary 8-isoprostane and vanadium-to-creatinine ratios rose 3.1-fold and 6.8-fold, respectively. Workers in the highest tertile of cumulative vanadium exposure exhibited an accelerated annual decline in FEF25-75 of 114 mL/year after adjustment for pack-years of smoking and age (p = 0.0029).

Background: Idiopathic granulomatous mastitis is frequently misdiagnosed as inflammatory breast carcinoma or tuberculous mastitis, leading to prolonged empiric antibiotic courses. Methods: We retrospectively reviewed 83 women diagnosed by ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy at Turku University Hospital and Uppsala University Hospital between 2015 and 2022. Multiplex 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing and matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry were performed on aspirates from 64 patients. Results: Corynebacterium kroppenstedtii was identified in 47 of 64 specimens (73.4%), with median lipophilic colony counts of 4.2 x 10^4 CFU/mL. Patients randomized to oral clarithromycin 500 mg twice daily plus intralesional triamcinolone acetonide 40 mg achieved complete clinical resolution at 16 weeks in 86.5% of cases compared with 51.9% receiving systemic prednisolone tapering alone (risk difference 34.6%, p = 0.0031).

Background and Objectives: Delayed cerebral ischemia following aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage is only partially explained by angiographic vasospasm of proximal Willisian vessels. We investigated whether cerebrospinal fluid levels of neurofilament light chain and soluble platelet-derived growth factor receptor beta (sPDGFRb) reflect pericyte shedding and microcirculatory failure. Methods: Ventricular CSF was sampled every 48 hours from day 1 to day 14 in 76 Hunt-Hess grade III-IV patients admitted to the Neurocritical Care Unit in Innsbruck. Results: Patients who developed CT-perfused territorial hypoperfusion (n = 29) displayed a steep rise in CSF sPDGFRb peaking on day 5 at a median of 1,840 pg/mL versus 610 pg/mL in non-ischemic patients (Mann-Whitney p = 0.00012). An sPDGFRb-to-albumin ratio exceeding 3.2 predicted 90-day modified Rankin Scale scores >= 3 with an area under the ROC curve of 0.87.

Loss-of-function variants in the lysosomal chloride-proton antiporter CLCN7 typically cause osteopetrosis, whereas gain-of-function missense substitutions have recently been implicated in hypopigmentation with organomegaly. Here we report a de novo heterozygous c.1642G>A (p.Gly548Ser) substitution in CLCN7 in a 7-year-old girl from Ljubljana presenting with oculocutaneous albinism, hepatosplenomegaly, and normal bone mineral density (lumbar Z-score +0.3). Whole-endolysosomal patch-clamp recordings in transiently transfected HEK293T cells revealed a 4.6-fold increase in outward chloride current density at +80 mV and abolition of voltage-dependent gating relaxation. Primary dermal fibroblasts from the proband accumulated giant autolysosomal vacuoles with a lumenal pH of 3.68 (control 4.52, p = 0.0014) that resolved upon treatment with 50 uM chloroquine for 48 hours.

Purpose: To evaluate whether perioperative intravenous lidocaine infusion attenuates glycocalyx shedding and acute kidney injury in patients undergoing cytoreductive surgery with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) using cisplatin and mitomycin C. Methods: In a double-blind randomized controlled trial at the Netherlands Cancer Institute and University Hospitals Leuven, 112 adults with peritoneal carcinomatosis of appendiceal or colorectal origin received either lidocaine (1.5 mg/kg bolus followed by 1.5 mg/kg/h for 24 hours) or 0.9% saline. Results: Plasma syndecan-1 at 6 hours post-perfusion was significantly lower in the lidocaine arm (median 68.4 ng/mL, IQR 44.1-102.0) than in controls (129.7 ng/mL, IQR 85.3-188.4; p = 0.0007). KDIGO stage 1-2 acute kidney injury occurred in 9 of 56 (16.1%) lidocaine-treated patients versus 21 of 56 (37.5%) controls (relative risk 0.43, p = 0.011).

Cryo-electron microscopy at 2.65 Angstrom resolution was used to determine the structure of the tripartite efflux pump MacAB-TolC from Acinetobacter baumannii strain ATCC 17978 bound to the cyclic lipopeptide colistin B and the macrolide erythromycin. Single-particle reconstructions in nanodiscs composed of 1-palmitoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine revealed an asymmetric periplasmic bellows ring in MacA that undergoes a 19-degree rigid-body iris rotation upon ATP hydrolysis by the MacB nucleotide-binding domains. Site-directed substitution of Trp143Ala and Phe198Leu within the outer membrane factor portal completely abolished colistin extrusion, reducing the minimum inhibitory concentration from 32 ug/mL to 0.5 ug/mL without altering outer membrane lipooligosaccharide phosphoethanolamine modification.

Autoantibodies against the paranodal cell adhesion molecule contactin-associated protein-like 2 (CASPR2) are associated with Morvan syndrome, limbic encephalitis, and acquired neuromyotonia, yet the contribution of IgG4 Fc glycosylation to blood-brain barrier transcytosis remains unclear. We purified polyclonal CASPR2-specific IgG4 and IgG1 fractions from serum and cerebrospinal fluid of 31 patients across four French reference centers. Capillary electrophoresis-electrospray ionization mass spectrometry demonstrated a 42% reduction in core galactosylation and bisected N-acetylglucosamine on intrathecal IgG4 relative to paired serum IgG4 (paired Wilcoxon p = 0.0003). In human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived brain microvascular endothelial transwell models, agalactosylated CASPR2 IgG4 disrupted kv1.1 juxtaparanodal clustering in myelinated dorsal root ganglion co-cultures within 36 hours.

Objectives: To determine whether maternal mid-gestation plasma concentrations of perfluorohexane sulfonic acid (PFHxS) and perfluorononanoic acid (PFNA) modify the association between placental DNA methylation of the IGF2/H19 imprinting control region and neonatal adiposity. Study Design: Among 642 mother-singleton pairs enrolled in the Odense Child Cohort, maternal serum PFAS was quantified at 18 weeks of gestation by isotope-dilution liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry, and cord blood plus chorionic villus pyrosequencing was performed at delivery. Results: Each doubling of maternal PFHxS (median 1.38 ng/mL) was associated with a 1.94% decrease in placental H19 DMR methylation (95% CI -2.81% to -1.07%, p = 0.00004) and a 112 g lower birth weight among male neonates (interaction p = 0.018), whereas female neonates showed no significant methylation shift.

Hepatic stellate cell transdifferentiation during non-alcoholic steatohepatitis is driven by mechanosensitive hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling, but pharmacological disruption of the TEAD palmitoylation pocket has been limited by hepatocyte bile salt export pump inhibition. We synthesized a series of spirocyclic dihydropyrrolones culminating in compound VTX-882, which covalently modifies Cys359 of TEAD1 and Cys380 of TEAD4 with a k_inact/K_I of 14,200 M-1 s-1 while sparing ABCB11 up to 50 uM. In choline-deficient L-amino acid-defined high-fat diet mice treated from week 6 to week 14 with 15 mg/kg/day oral VTX-882, Sirius Red-quantified bridging fibrosis area decreased from 8.4% to 2.7% (p = 0.0002), hepatic hydroxyproline content dropped by 57%, and single-nucleus RNA-seq confirmed selective depletion of Col1a1+ Cthrc1+ myofibroblasts.

We report an outbreak of cutaneous sporotrichosis caused by Sporothrix brasiliensis transmitted by domestic felines in the metropolitan region of Curitiba, Parana, affecting 48 patients between October 2021 and May 2023. Clinical forms included lymphocutaneous (64.6%), fixed cutaneous (27.1%), and disseminated immunoreactive erythema nodosum (8.3%). Calmodulin gene sequencing assigned all 48 clinical isolates and 19 matched feline nasal swab isolates to clonal genotype Sb-Clade IIa. Three human isolates from patients failing 16 weeks of oral itraconazole (200 mg/day) exhibited elevated itraconazole MICs of 8-16 ug/mL associated with a Tyr132Phe substitution in CYP51 and overexpression of the ABC transporter gene CDR1, but responded completely to oral terbinafine 250 mg twice daily over 12 weeks.

Retinal ganglion cell somata degenerate asynchronously after acute optic nerve crush, with alpha-like intrinsically photosensitive subtypes displaying marked resilience. Using single-cell patch-seq combined with heavy-isotope metabolic labeling in Thy1-GCaMP6f mice at 3, 7, and 14 days post-axotomy, we profiled 2,940 individual retinal ganglion cells across 28 transcriptomic clusters. Survival of M1 Opn4+ cells (84.2% at day 14) depended on constitutive activation of the endoplasmic reticulum unfolded protein response sensor ATF6alpha and upregulation of the selenoprotein GPX4. Intravitreal injection of adeno-associated virus serotype 2 encoding a dominant-negative ATF6alpha construct reduced M1 survival to 29.5% (p < 0.0001), whereas overexpressing GPX4 rescued vulnerable Cartpt+ ON-OFF direction-selective ganglion cells from 18.1% to 63.7% preservation.

Aim: To assess whether circadian misalignment induced by rotating night-shift work alters gut mucosal barrier permeability and fecal short-chain fatty acid profiles in nurses with quiescent ulcerative colitis. Methods: Forty-six female nurses in clinical remission (Mayo endoscopic subscore 0-1) at Haukeland University Hospital in Bergen completed a 14-day actigraphy protocol covering a 4-night shift block and a matched day-shift block. Results: Following night shifts, urinary lactulose-to-mannitol excretion ratios increased from 0.019 to 0.044 (p = 0.0005), fecal calprotectin rose from a median of 48 ug/g to 164 ug/g, and fecal butyrate fell by 38.4% alongside a 5.2-fold depletion of Faecalibacterium prausnitzii phylogroup II. Salivary dim-light melatonin onset shifted by 4.3 hours and inversely correlated with serum zonulin (r = -0.61, p = 0.0001).

Primary hyperoxaluria type 3 results from biallelic variants in HOGA1, encoding mitochondrial 4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate aldolase, and was historically considered benign in adulthood. We evaluated 53 genetically confirmed patients across the European Hyperoxaluria Consortium Registry with a median follow-up of 14.8 years (range 3.2-44.0). Compound heterozygosity for the splice-site variant c.700+5G>T and the in-frame deletion p.Glu315del accounted for 62% of alleles. Twenty-four-hour urinary oxalate excretion averaged 0.89 mmol/1.73 m2, accompanied by urinary 4-hydroxy-glutamate levels of 142 umol/mmol creatinine. Nephrocalcinosis was documented in 19 patients (35.8%), and 7 patients (13.2%) progressed to chronic kidney disease stage 3b or 4 by age 45, challenging the view that HOGA1 deficiency never compromises long-term renal function.

Background: Stereotactic magnetic resonance-guided adaptive radiotherapy (SMART) permits ablative dose escalation for locally advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma abutting the duodenum, yet acute mucosal toxicity remains dose-limiting. Methods: In a phase II single-arm trial at Heidelberg University Hospital and Erasmus MC, 62 patients with borderline resectable or locally advanced tumors received 50 Gy in 5 fractions on a 0.35-Tesla MR-Linac with daily online plan adaptation constraining 0.5 cm3 of the duodenum to <= 33 Gy. Results: Daily online re-optimization was required in 274 of 310 delivered fractions (88.4%), reducing median duodenal D0.5cc from 39.8 Gy (predicted on baseline anatomy) to 31.2 Gy (p < 0.0001). Grade >= 3 gastrointestinal bleeding or ulceration occurred in only 2 patients (3.2%), while 1-year local control and overall survival reached 87.1% and 79.0%.

Skeletal muscle insulin resistance in myotonic dystrophy type 1 is classically attributed to aberrant alternative splicing of the insulin receptor exon 11 by toxic CUG-expanded DMPK transcripts. By performing quantitative phosphoproteomics on vastus lateralis biopsies from 27 patients with 350 to 1,100 CTG repeats and 20 age-matched controls in Padua, we discovered that basal phosphorylation of TBC1D4 (AS160) at Thr642 and Ser588 was elevated 2.8-fold despite 65% exclusion of INSR exon 11. Instead, sequestration of MBNL1 caused mis-splicing of exon 18 of the syntaxin-binding protein STXBP4, trapping GLUT4 storage vesicles at the trans-Golgi network. Antisense morpholino oligonucleotides restoring STXBP4 canonical splicing rescued insulin-stimulated 2-deoxyglucose uptake in patient myotubes from 39% to 91% of control levels (p = 0.0003).

Canine visceral leishmaniasis and ehrlichiosis co-infection complicates hematological interpretation in endemic Mediterranean basins. Between April 2020 and September 2022, 184 shelter dogs from Crete and Thessaly presenting with epistaxis, lymphadenomegaly, or pancytopenia underwent bone marrow aspiration, quantitative real-time PCR for Leishmania infantum kinetoplast DNA and Ehrlichia canis 16S rDNA, and platelet aggregometry. Dual infection was confirmed in 43 dogs (23.4%), which exhibited significantly lower mean platelet counts (38 x 10^9/L vs 112 x 10^9/L in mono-infected L. infantum dogs, p < 0.0001) and elevated anti-glycoprotein IIb/IIIa IgG titers. Combined therapy with miltefosine (2 mg/kg/day for 28 days), allopurinol (10 mg/kg twice daily), and doxycycline (10 mg/kg/day for 28 days) normalized megakaryocytic dysplasia in 37 of 43 animals by day 60.

Objective: To determine whether acoustic radiation force impulse (ARFI) elastography of the parotid and submandibular glands improves diagnostic classification in early seronegative primary Sjogren syndrome. Methods: Ninety-four patients with sicca symptoms of < 24 months duration, negative anti-SSA/Ro60 and anti-SSB/La antibodies, and unstimulated whole salivary flow <= 0.1 mL/min underwent bilateral salivary shear-wave velocity measurement followed by labial minor salivary gland biopsy at Newcastle upon Tyne Hospitals. Results: Parotid shear-wave velocity averaged 2.84 +/- 0.43 m/s in the 38 patients with a focus score >= 1.0 versus 1.91 +/- 0.28 m/s in the 56 biopsy-negative patients (p < 0.0001). Combining a parotid cutoff of 2.45 m/s with tear film osmolarity > 316 mOsm/L yielded a sensitivity of 89.5% and specificity of 91.1%.

Bacteriophage therapy targeting multidrug-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa in cystic fibrosis lung infections is frequently undermined by rapid emergence of lipopolysaccharide O-antigen truncation mutants. Here we isolated a podovirus, phiPA-Oslo7, from hospital wastewater in Rikshospitalet that utilizes the outer membrane ferripyoverdine receptor FpvA as its primary adsorption receptor. In a 14-day hollow-fiber biofilm reactor inoculated with the Liverpool epidemic strain LESB58, a dual-phage cocktail pairing phiPA-Oslo7 with the type IV pilus-dependent myovirus phiKZ reduced biofilm viable counts by 5.6 log10 CFU/cm2. Phage-resistant clones acquiring fpvA nonsense mutations lost pyoverdine-mediated iron scavenging, suffered a 4.2-fold attenuation in murine intranasal lethality, and became resensitized to aztreonam (MIC decrease from 64 to 4 mg/L).

Context: Congenital adrenal hyperplasia due to 11-beta-hydroxylase deficiency (CYP11B1) accounts for 5-8% of cases globally but occurs at higher frequency in North African and Anatolian populations, predisposing to hypokalemic hypertension and virilization. Design: We analyzed clinical, steroidomic, and molecular profiles of 41 patients from 29 consanguineous kindreds evaluated at Ankara City Hospital and Sfax Hedi Chaker Hospital. Results: Liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry revealed serum 11-deoxycortisol concentrations of 84.5 +/- 31.2 nmol/L (reference < 3.0) and 11-deoxycorticosterone of 14.8 +/- 6.1 nmol/L. Three founder mutations (p.Gly379Val, p.Arg448His, and the frameshift c.1179_1180dupGA) represented 79.3% of mutant alleles. Bilateral adrenal myelolipomas > 3 cm developed in 6 of 14 poorly controlled adults aged > 25 years.

Microglia-derived complement component C1q mediates developmental synaptic pruning, yet its reactivation in chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE) has not been spatially mapped relative to sulcal tau astrogliopathy. Using 38-plex imaging mass cytometry on postmortem dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (Brodmann area 9) from 24 former contact-sport athletes with stage II-IV CTE and 16 neuropathologically normal controls from the Boston and Glasgow brain banks, we quantified 412,000 individual cellular neighborhoods within 150 um of sulcal depths. C1qA and C3d colocalized specifically with excitatory PSD-95 puncta apposed to perivascular p-tau231+ thorny astrocytes (enrichment z-score = 7.82, p < 0.0001), whereas deep gyral crest neuropil showed preserved synaptic density despite equivalent total neurofibrillary tangle burden.

Background: Mutations in the splicing factor SF3B1 (most commonly p.Lys700Glu) define myelodysplastic syndrome with ring sideroblasts and induce aberrant 3' splice-site usage in ABCB7 and PPOX, disturbing mitochondrial heme biosynthesis. Methods: We performed single-cell multiome ATAC plus nuclear RNA sequencing on CD34+ bone marrow progenitors from 15 SF3B1-K700E patients and 9 healthy age-matched donors at Karolinska University Hospital. Results: Erythroid-committed burst-forming units exhibited premature chromatin opening at GATA1-binding enhancers of the erythroferrone gene ERFE, driving a 6.4-fold surge in plasma erythroferrone (median 42.8 ng/mL vs 6.7 ng/mL, p < 0.0001) prior to red blood cell transfusion dependency. Pharmacological inhibition of the bromodomain protein BRD9 with 200 nM dBRD9-A selectively suppressed cryptic splicing of BRD9 poison exons and restored terminal enucleation ex vivo.

Transcatheter tricuspid valve edge-to-edge repair reduces venous congestion in severe functional tricuspid regurgitation, but its acute effect on hepatic sinusoidal stiffness and splanchnic venous capacitance has not been prospectively quantified. Fifty-two patients (median age 78 years, EuroSCORE II 6.4%) undergoing TriClip implantation at Bern University Hospital and Mainz University Medical Center underwent hepatic vein catheterization, two-dimensional shear-wave elastography, and indocyanine green plasma disappearance rate (ICG-PDR) testing before and 30 days after repair. Reduction of tricuspid regurgitation by >= 2 grades (achieved in 84.6%) lowered the hepatic venous pressure gradient from 5.8 +/- 1.9 mmHg to 3.1 +/- 1.2 mmHg, decreased liver stiffness from 14.6 to 8.9 kPa (p < 0.0001), and increased ICG-PDR from 11.4%/min to 17.8%/min.

Aim: To investigate whether embryonic diapause-like dormancy in minimal residual disease of estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer is maintained by the histone H4 lysine 20 methyltransferase KMT5B (SUV420H1). Methods: Using a barcode-tracked organoid dormancy model derived from 12 luminal B primary tumors and matched bone marrow disseminated tumor cells collected at Institut Curie, we conducted a CRISPR-Cas9 epigenetic screen under 90-day fulvestrant deprivation. Results: Loss of KMT5B triggered exit from G0 arrest, abolished H4K20me2 enrichment at pericentromeric satellite repeats, and induced cGAS-STING-dependent interferon-beta secretion within 10 days. In NSG mice bearing intraductal MCF7-Luc xenografts treated with palbociclib plus letrozole, co-administration of the selective KMT5B inhibitor A-196 (25 mg/kg intraperitoneally) eradicated 88% of Ki-67-negative persister cells and prevented post-withdrawal relapse over 180 days.

Background: Venom-induced consumption coagulopathy following bites by the Russell viper (Daboia russelii) in Sri Lanka is frequently complicated by thrombotic microangiopathy and dialysis-dependent acute kidney injury despite timely polyvalent antivenom administration. Methods: We prospectively enrolled 106 envenomed agricultural workers admitted to Anuradhapura Teaching Hospital within 6 hours of bite. Serial plasma ADAMTS13 activity, ultra-large von Willebrand factor multimers, and soluble C5b-9 were assayed at admission, 12, 24, and 72 hours. Results: Nineteen patients (17.9%) developed microangiopathic hemolytic anemia with schistocytosis > 2% and thrombocytopenia < 50 x 10^9/L. Unlike classic thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura, ADAMTS13 activity remained > 40% (median 62%), whereas plasma sC5b-9 exceeded 890 ng/mL (vs 245 ng/mL in uncomplicated coagulopathy, p < 0.0001), implicating alternative complement pathway overactivation.

Sensory hair cell mechanoelectrical transduction in the mammalian cochlea requires precise tensioning of tip links composed of cadherin-23 and protocadherin-15 by the unconventional myosin motor MYO7A. Here we characterized a knock-in mouse model harboring the human Usher syndrome type 1B missense variant Myo7a p.Arg212His. High-speed fluid-jet deflection of outer hair cell stereocilia bundles from postnatal day 8 apical cochlear coils revealed a 58 mV rightward shift in the current-displacement activation curve and a 3.4-fold slowing of fast calcium-dependent adaptation time constants (tau_fast = 0.89 ms vs 0.26 ms in wild-type littermates, p = 0.0002). Dual-AAV-PHP.eB trans-splicing delivery of full-length Myo7a cDNA through the round window membrane at postnatal day 2 restored auditory brainstem response thresholds at 16 kHz from > 95 dB SPL to 38 dB SPL at 12 weeks.

Background & Aims: Primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) carries a 400-fold increased lifetime risk of cholangiocarcinoma, yet brush cytology during endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography has a sensitivity below 45%. We evaluated whether methylation-specific droplet digital PCR of cell-free DNA in bile aspirates improves detection of biliary dysplasia and early-stage perihilar cholangiocarcinoma. Methods: Bile was aspirated from dominant strictures in 148 PSC patients across Oslo, Helsinki, and Stockholm hepatobiliary centers (34 with histologically confirmed cholangiocarcinoma or high-grade dysplasia, 114 with benign inflammatory strictures). Results: A four-marker methylation panel (CDO1, CNRIP1, SEPT9, and VIM) achieved 91.2% sensitivity and 94.7% specificity (AUC 0.964), outperforming serum CA19-9 > 129 U/mL (sensitivity 52.9%, specificity 81.6%; DeLong p = 0.0001).

Endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EndMT) contributes to neointimal hyperplasia and vein graft failure after coronary artery bypass grafting. By profiling saphenous vein remnants from 89 patients undergoing surgical revascularization at Royal Papworth Hospital and exposing ex vivo human saphenous vein rings to arterial pulsatile shear stress (120/80 mmHg, 15 dyn/cm2) for 7 days, we identified the deubiquitinase USP14 as a post-translational stabilizer of the transcription factor SNAI2 (Slug). USP14 deubiquitinated Lys48-linked polyubiquitin chains on SNAI2 at residue Lys166, preventing proteasomal turnover and repressing VE-cadherin transcription. Luminal incubation of vein grafts for 30 minutes prior to anastomosis with the small-molecule USP14 inhibitor IU1-47 (20 uM) reduced 28-day neointimal-to-medial area ratios in a porcine carotid interposition model by 64% (p = 0.0004).

Purpose: To investigate whether deep hypothermic circulatory arrest versus selective antegrade cerebral perfusion at 26 degrees Celsius alters postoperative blood-brain barrier integrity and neurocognitive trajectories in acute Stanford type A aortic dissection repair. Methods: In a randomized study at Bologna Sant'Orsola Hospital and Medical University of Vienna, 96 patients undergoing hemiarch or total arch replacement were assigned 1:1 to bilateral antegrade cerebral perfusion at 26 C or deep hypothermic arrest at 18 C. Results: Dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI on postoperative day 6 showed a 48% lower hippocampal volume transfer constant Ktrans in the 26 C antegrade perfusion group (0.0041 vs 0.0079 min-1, p = 0.0009). Montreal Cognitive Assessment scores at 90 days declined by >= 3 points in 12.5% versus 33.3% of patients (p = 0.015).

Cutaneous leishmaniasis caused by Leishmania aethiopica in the central highlands of Ethiopia frequently manifests as diffuse non-ulcerating nodules refractory to pentavalent antimonials. We conducted whole-genome sequencing of 54 clinical promastigote isolates obtained from skin scrapings in Dessie and Addis Ababa between 2018 and 2022, alongside double-stranded RNA virus screening. Twenty-nine isolates (53.7%) harbored Leishmania RNA virus LRV-Lae, which induced Toll-like receptor 3-dependent interleukin-10 and type I interferon production in human primary monocyte-derived macrophages (3.9-fold higher IL-10 at 24 hours, p = 0.0002). Clinical cure at day 90 following liposomal amphotericin B (total dose 24 mg/kg) plus oral miltefosine was achieved in 88.0% of LRV-negative patients compared with 51.7% of LRV-positive patients (odds ratio 6.84, p = 0.0056).

Background: Autosomal dominant tubulointerstitial kidney disease caused by UMOD mutations (ADTKD-UMOD) results from misfolding and endoplasmic reticulum retention of uromodulin in thick ascending limb epithelial cells. Methods: Using patient-derived kidney organoids carrying the canonical p.Cys150Ser mutation and knock-in UmodC148W/+ mice, we tested whether pharmacological activation of the TMED9 cargo receptor clearance pathway by BRD4780 restores trafficking. Results: Fourteen days of oral BRD4780 (30 mg/kg/day) cleared intracellular polymeric uromodulin aggregates by 76% via TMED9-directed lysosomal routing, normalized urinary uromodulin-to-creatinine excretion from 1.8 to 9.4 mg/g, and suppressed tubular KIM-1 and LCN2 expression. At 9 months of age, treated UmodC148W/+ mice exhibited serum blood urea nitrogen of 29.4 mg/dL compared with 64.1 mg/dL in vehicle-treated littermates (p < 0.0001).

Objectives: To determine whether dynamic pupillometry parameters combined with plasma glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) measured in the prehospital helicopter emergency medical setting accurately triage severe traumatic brain injury requiring neurosurgical decompression. Methods: Across 312 blunt head trauma patients (Glasgow Coma Scale 3-12) transported by Swiss Air-Rescue Rega and ADAC Air Rescue over 18 months, automated neurological pupil index (NPi) and point-of-care capillary blood GFAP were recorded within 35 minutes of injury. Results: An NPi < 3.0 in either eye paired with plasma GFAP > 1,450 pg/mL identified patients requiring craniotomy or decompressive craniectomy within 12 hours (n = 58) with 94.8% sensitivity, 92.1% specificity, and a negative predictive value of 98.7%.

Intratumoral tertiary lymphoid structures (TLS) predict favorable responses to PD-1 blockade in muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma, but the metabolic determinants of germinal center B-cell maturation within TLS remain undefined. Spatial transcriptomics (10x Visium HD) and imaging mass spectrometry of cystectomy specimens from 49 patients treated with neoadjuvant nivolumab plus ipilimumab in the NABUCCO-expansion cohort revealed that immature, BCL6-negative lymphoid aggregates were surrounded by IDO1+ LAMP3+ regulatory dendritic cells accumulating kynurenine (> 18 uM local tissue concentration). Kynurenine activated aryl hydrocarbon receptor signaling in infiltrating naive B cells, upregulating BLIMP1 while repressing AICDA (AID) class-switch recombination. Epacadostat-mediated IDO1 inhibition in syngeneic MB49 bladder tumors restored CXCR5+ BCL6+ germinal center formation and doubled complete pathological response rates.

Background: Maternal autoantibodies reactive with fetal brain proteins have been implicated in a subset of autism spectrum disorder, yet their fine epitope specificity on the voltage-gated potassium channel complex subunit DPP6 has not been mapped. Methods: Using a phage immunoprecipitation sequencing (PhIP-seq) library tiling 720,000 overlapping 49-mer peptides across the human proteome, we screened mid-pregnancy serum collected at 16 weeks of gestation from 380 mothers in the Norwegian Mother, Father and Child Cohort Study (MoBa) whose children received a specialist diagnosis of autism by age 8, alongside 380 matched controls. Results: High-titer IgG recognizing an extracellular beta-propeller loop of DPP6 (residues 312-348) was present in 19 of 380 case mothers (5.0%) versus 1 of 380 controls (0.26%; Fisher exact p = 0.00003). Passive transfer of affinity-purified human anti-DPP6 IgG into pregnant C57BL/6 dams on embryonic days 13-16 increased dendritic spine turnover in Layer 2/3 somatosensory pyramidal neurons of offspring.

Purpose: We evaluated whether combining low-dose oral lonafarnib with the farnesyl pyrophosphate synthase inhibitor zoledronate and pegylated interferon-lambda-1a accelerates hepatitis delta virus (HDV) RNA clearance in patients with compensated cirrhosis. Methods: In an open-label phase II study in Bucharest and Chisinau, 44 HBsAg-positive adults with baseline serum HDV RNA > 4.0 log10 IU/mL and FibroScan liver stiffness 12.5-24.0 kPa received lonafarnib 50 mg plus ritonavir 100 mg twice daily, subcutaneous peginterferon-lambda 180 ug weekly, and intravenous zoledronate 4 mg every 8 weeks for 24 weeks. Results: At week 24, median HDV RNA declined by 3.84 log10 IU/mL, with 23 of 44 patients (52.3%) achieving undetectable HDV RNA (< 14 IU/mL) and 17 of 44 (38.6%) maintaining virological suppression 24 weeks off therapy.

Pathogenic repeat expansions in the intron of RFC1 cause cerebellar ataxia, neuropathy, and vestibular areflexia syndrome (CANVAS), typically involving biallelic (AAGGG)exp pentanucleotide configurations. Through long-read PacBio HiFi sequencing of 162 unexplained late-onset sensory neuronopathy patients across six Italian and Spanish neuromuscular clinics, we identified 11 individuals from 8 unrelated families carrying a novel compound heterozygous configuration: one canonical (AAGGG)n allele (850-1,400 repeats) paired in trans with an interrupted (AAAGG)12(AAGGG)110(ACAGGG)480 hexanucleotide-hybrid expansion. Sural nerve biopsies from three patients demonstrated severe depletion of myelinated fibers (> 85% loss) without onion-bulb formations, while skin biopsy PGP9.5 immunostaining confirmed length-dependent intraepidermal nerve fiber density below 0.8 fibers/mm at the distal leg.

Background: Acute mesenteric ischemia carries a mortality rate exceeding 50% largely due to delayed differentiation between reversible mucosal ischemia and transmural bowel necrosis. Methods: We prospectively evaluated plasma intestinal fatty acid-binding protein (I-FABP), D-lactate, and smooth muscle myosin heavy chain (SMMHC) alongside dual-energy computed tomography iodine density mapping in 128 consecutive patients presenting with acute superior mesenteric artery thromboembolism at Lille University Hospital and Charite Berlin. Results: Transmural necrosis requiring bowel resection was confirmed at laparotomy in 67 patients (52.3%). A bowel wall iodine uptake < 0.95 mg/mL in the portal venous phase combined with plasma SMMHC > 4.2 ng/mL predicted irreversible transmural necrosis with 95.5% sensitivity and 93.4% specificity (AUC 0.972), reducing non-therapeutic laparotomies by 31%.

Tick-borne relapsing fever caused by Borrelia hispanica is an underrecognized etiology of recurrent febrile episodes and lymphocytic meningitis in travelers returning from the Iberian Peninsula and Morocco. Between June 2017 and October 2023, we identified 29 PCR-confirmed cases across seven tropical medicine centers in Spain and France using a pan-relapsing fever glpQ real-time assay followed by multi-locus sequence typing of flaB, rrs, and igs loci. Giemsa-stained thick blood films were initially read as negative in 13 of 29 patients (44.8%) due to low spirochetemia (< 10^3 spirochetes/mL) during inter-febrile intervals. Four patients presented with facial nerve diplegia and cerebrospinal fluid pleocytosis (median 195 leukocytes/uL). Jarisch-Herxheimer reactions occurred in 11 patients (37.9%) within 3 hours of initiating doxycycline 100 mg twice daily.

Objective: To determine whether selective inhibition of the sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) by dapagliflozin reduces intrarenal cortical hypoxia and urinary mitochondrial DNA excretion in non-diabetic patients with IgA nephropathy and persistent proteinuria. Methods: Fifty-eight biopsy-proven IgA nephropathy patients (eGFR 35-75 mL/min/1.73 m2, proteinuria 1.0-3.5 g/day on maximally tolerated ramipril) at Kyoto University Hospital and Nagoya University Hospital underwent blood oxygen level-dependent (BOLD) 3-Tesla renal MRI at baseline and 16 weeks after randomization to dapagliflozin 10 mg/day or placebo. Results: Dapagliflozin lowered cortical R2* relaxation rates from 19.8 +/- 1.7 s-1 to 16.9 +/- 1.4 s-1 (placebo-adjusted difference -2.6 s-1, p = 0.0001), reduced urinary ND1/COX3 mitochondrial DNA copy numbers by 54%, and decreased 24-hour proteinuria by 36.2%.

Background: Osteonecrosis of the jaw associated with antiresorptive therapy (MRONJ) involves impaired gingival mucosal healing and Actinomyces-dominated polymicrobial biofilms, but host genetic modifiers of susceptibility in breast cancer patients receiving denosumab remain unknown. Methods: We performed a genome-wide association study and targeted exome sequencing in 192 MRONJ cases and 768 denosumab-exposed controls matched for cumulative dose and treatment duration across the German Oncology Osteology Network. Results: A rare missense variant in MMP8 encoding neutrophil collagenase (rs17099443, p.Lys87Glu, minor allele frequency 0.094 in cases vs 0.023 in controls; odds ratio 4.41, p = 3.8 x 10^-9) and a promoter polymorphism in VEGFA (-2578C>A) were independently associated with stage 2-3 jaw necrosis. Mutant pro-MMP8 exhibited 61% reduced activation by gingival Porphyromonas gingivalis gingipains.

Allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation complicated by steroid-refractory acute gastrointestinal graft-versus-host disease (GI-aGVHD) is driven by donor alloreactive Th1/Tc1 lymphocytes destroying Lgr5+ intestinal crypt stem cells. In a phase Ib/II multicenter trial across Munich, Zurich, and Vienna, 39 patients with grade III-IV steroid-refractory GI-aGVHD received ruxolitinib (10 mg twice daily) combined with colonoscopic fecal microbiota transplantation from pooled screened donors containing >= 35% Lachnospiraceae and Ruminococcaceae species at days 1, 8, and 15. Overall response at day 28 reached 74.4% (complete response 53.8%), accompanied by a 4.8-fold rise in plasma indole-3-propionic acid and regeneration of Paneth cell alpha-defensin HD5 on sigmoid biopsies. Six-month non-relapse mortality was 17.9%.

We investigated the structural basis by which the emerging orthohantavirus Seoul virus nucleocapsid protein (N) sequesters host processing-body (P-body) decapping enzyme DCP1A/DCP2 to snatch 5'-capped mRNA leaders for viral transcription priming. Hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry and solution NMR spectroscopy mapped a conserved hydrophobic groove between alpha-helices 6 and 7 of the N oligomerization core (residues Ile182-Leu209) that binds the EVH1 domain of human DCP1A with a K_d of 140 nM. Mutating Tyr194Ala in recombinant Seoul virus rescued by reverse genetics abrogated cap-snatching from host nonsense-mediated decay targets in primary rat lung microvascular endothelial cells, reducing infectious progeny titers by 3.7 log10 FFU/mL at 48 hours post-infection.

Purpose: To evaluate whether preoperative three-dimensional printing of patient-specific titanium osteotomy guides combined with vascularized fibular free flap reconstruction improves mandibular condylar seating accuracy and masticatory bite force after segmental mandibulectomy for ameloblastoma. Methods: Sixty-four patients across Shanghai Ninth People's Hospital and Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hospital were randomized to computer-aided 3D-printed titanium cutting/positioning plates (n = 32) or conventional hand-bent reconstruction plates with stereolithographic models (n = 32). Results: Postoperative cone-beam CT superimposition at 6 months demonstrated a mean condylar head linear deviation of 0.88 +/- 0.31 mm in the 3D-printed guide group versus 2.47 +/- 0.74 mm in controls (p < 0.0001), alongside higher ipsilateral first-molar occlusal force (268 N vs 189 N, p = 0.0002).

Background: Neonatal hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) treated with therapeutic hypothermia for 72 hours at 33.5 degrees Celsius still results in death or moderate-to-severe neurodevelopmental disability in nearly 40% of infants. We examined whether continuous amplitude-integrated electroencephalography (aEEG) spindle-burst entropy coupled with serum ubiquitin C-terminal hydrolase L1 (UCH-L1) during rewarming predicts basal ganglia-thalamus injury on day-7 diffusion-weighted MRI. Methods: Ninety-one term neonates (gestational age >= 36 weeks, cord arterial pH <= 7.00 or base deficit >= 16 mmol/L) in Gothenburg and Lund were prospectively monitored. Results: A failure of aEEG multiscale entropy to exceed 0.62 during the 6-hour rewarming phase combined with 72-hour serum UCH-L1 > 85 ng/mL predicted Rutherford score >= 2 basal ganglia lesions with 93.1% sensitivity and 95.2% specificity.

Chronic Chagas cardiomyopathy is characterized by focal myocardial fibrosis, conduction system blocks, and malignant ventricular arrhythmias decades after Trypanosoma cruzi infection. In a longitudinal cohort of 246 seropositive adults with preserved left ventricular ejection fraction (>= 50%) followed for 5.0 years at the Heart Institute (InCor) in Sao Paulo, baseline cardiac magnetic resonance T1 mapping and serum galectin-3 plus soluble ST2 were measured. Mid-wall late gadolinium enhancement involving >= 4.5% of left ventricular mass was present in 68 patients (27.6%). Over follow-up, 34 patients experienced sustained ventricular tachycardia, implantable cardioverter-defibrillator shock, or progression to ejection fraction < 40%; extracellular volume fraction >= 29.8% paired with galectin-3 > 17.2 ng/mL independently predicted the composite outcome (adjusted HR 5.18, 95% CI 2.49-10.76, p < 0.0001).

Background and Aims: Eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE) refractory to proton pump inhibitors and topical swallowed budesonide is increasingly managed with elimination diets or biologics, yet mucosal impedance biomarkers of epithelial barrier restoration remain underutilized. Methods: Seventy-two adults with active EoE (>= 15 eosinophils per high-power field) at University Hospital Zurich and Academic Medical Center Amsterdam underwent pan-esophageal mucosal admittance testing via balloon-mounted impedance catheters before and 12 weeks after subcutaneous dupilumab 300 mg weekly. Results: Histological remission (< 6 eos/hpf) was achieved in 59 of 72 patients (81.9%), accompanied by a 3.3-fold increase in distal esophageal baseline impedance from 1,140 +/- 390 Ohms to 3,780 +/- 620 Ohms (p < 0.0001) and normalization of desmoglein-1 and filaggrin immunostaining.

Loss of the chromatin remodeler ARID1A is the most frequent genetic alteration in ovarian clear cell carcinoma and creates a synthetic lethal dependency on glutathione biosynthesis via SLC7A11 downregulation. Here we report that ARID1A-deficient tumors acquire adaptive resistance to the glutamate-cystine antiporter inhibitor erastin by upregulating the transsulfuration pathway enzyme cystathionine beta-synthase (CBS) through NRF2 stabilization. In a panel of 14 patient-derived ovarian clear cell carcinoma xenografts (8 ARID1A-null, 6 ARID1A-wild-type), co-treatment with the brain-penetrant CBS allosteric inhibitor CH004 (20 mg/kg/day) and imidazole ketone erastin (15 mg/kg/day) induced complete tumor regression in 7 of 8 ARID1A-null models while sparing ARID1A-wild-type tumors and normal renal tubular epithelium.

Background: Autosomal-dominant tubulointerstitial kidney disease caused by mucin-1 frameshift insertions frequently progresses to end-stage renal failure before age 55. Methods: In the prospective RENAL-MUC19 cohort across five Scandinavian nephrology centers, 168 carriers of the 27-bp cytosine-tract duplication were treated with the small-molecule cargo-receptor modulator BRD-4780 (75 mg twice daily, n=84) or placebo (n=84) for 48 weeks. Results: BRD-4780 reduced urinary intracellular mucin-fs vesicle shedding by 71.4% (95% CI, 64.2 to 78.6; p<0.0001) and attenuated annual eGFR decline from -4.38 to -1.29 mL/min/1.73 m2 (difference, 3.09; p=0.0004). Transient mild hyperuricemia occurred in 10.7% of BRD-4780 recipients. Conclusions: TMED9-directed lysosomal rerouting slows renal function loss in MUC1 frameshift nephropathy.

Background: Resistance to third-generation EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors in leptomeningeal non-small-cell lung cancer is frequently driven by tertiary C797S cis mutations and MET amplification. Methods: We evaluated the brain-penetrant macrocyclic EGFR/MET dual inhibitor AZD-9941 in 94 patients with cytologically confirmed leptomeningeal carcinomatosis enrolled in the phase 1b/2 MENINGE-LUNG trial across seven Japanese oncology centers. Results: At the recommended expansion dose of 160 mg once daily, intracranial objective response rate by RANO-LM criteria was 58.5% (95% CI, 47.9 to 68.6), with median leptomeningeal progression-free survival of 11.4 months (IQR, 7.2 to 16.9) and cerebrospinal fluid unbound drug-to-plasma ratio of 0.83. Grade 3 paronychia or rash occurred in 12.8% of patients. Conclusions: AZD-9941 achieves high central nervous system exposure and durable cytologic clearance in TKI-refractory leptomeningeal NSCLC.

Background: Chronic chikungunya virus arthritis mimics seronegative rheumatoid disease and persists in over one-third of infected adults despite viral clearance from peripheral blood. Methods: In a double-blind trial in Recife and Fortaleza, 236 patients with synovial biopsy-confirmed persistent post-chikungunya polyarthritis exceeding 9 months were randomized to receive the selective JAK1/TYK2 inhibitor brepocitinib-analog VTX-512 (30 mg daily, n=118) or methotrexate (15 mg weekly, n=118) for 24 weeks. Results: Clinical remission (DAS28-CRP <2.6) at week 24 was achieved in 61.9% of VTX-512 recipients versus 33.1% of methotrexate recipients (adjusted risk difference, 28.8%; p<0.0001). Synovial CD8+ granzyme-K+ T-cell transcripts declined by 3.6-fold in the VTX-512 arm. Conclusions: Dual JAK1/TYK2 blockade outperforms methotrexate in chronic post-alphaviral inflammatory arthritis.

Background: Cerebral cavernous malformations arise from somatic and germline loss-of-function variants in KRIT1, CCM2, or PDCD10 that derepress MEKK3-KLF2/4 endothelial signaling. Methods: We conducted a randomized, placebo-controlled phase 2a study (CAVERN-RHO08) of the selective ROCK2 inhibitor belumosudil-derivative KD-045 (200 mg daily) in 112 patients with familial multifocal cerebral cavernous malformations across nine North American centers over 18 months. Results: Quantitative susceptibility mapping on 7-Tesla MRI demonstrated a mean lesional iron accrual change of -6.4% per year in KD-045 recipients compared with +14.8% per year in placebo controls (p=0.0002). Symptomatic lesional hemorrhage or new focal neurologic deficit occurred in 3.6% of KD-045 patients versus 16.1% of controls (hazard ratio, 0.21; p=0.014). Conclusions: Selective ROCK2 inhibition stabilizes vascular permeability and iron deposition in familial cerebral cavernous malformations.

Background: Congenital hyperinsulinism due to inactivating ABCC8 potassium-channel mutations often fails diazoxide therapy, necessitating near-total pancreatectomy in infancy. Methods: In the multicenter open-label INSUL-GLP9 trial, 46 diazoxide-unresponsive infants aged 3 weeks to 14 months received continuous subcutaneous infusion of the long-acting GLP-1 receptor inverse agonist exendin-(9-39) conjugate XW-009 (0.45 mg/kg/day) for 16 weeks. Results: Fasting euglycemia (>3.9 mmol/L for 8 hours without intravenous dextrose) was achieved in 39 of 46 infants (84.8%), allowing complete weaning from central venous glucose infusion at a median of 11 days (IQR, 6 to 18). Subtotal pancreatectomy was avoided in 89.1% of participants through 12 months of follow-up. Conclusions: GLP-1 receptor inverse agonism restores glycemic stability and prevents pancreatectomy in KATP-channel congenital hyperinsulinism.

Background: Idiopathic subglottic stenosis is a fibroinflammatory airway disorder predominantly affecting perimenopausal women and requiring repeated endoscopic dilations. Methods: We analyzed single-cell spatial transcriptomics and T-cell receptor repertoires from subglottic mucosal biopsies of 64 untreated patients and 32 healthy tracheal controls across the North American Airway Collaborative, followed by a pilot study of serial intralesional IL-17A/F bispecific nanobody SL-308 injections in 28 recurrent cases. Results: Fibrotic lamina propria niches harbored clonally expanded mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells co-expressing RORC and amphiregulin that activated COL11A1+ myofibroblasts (p<0.0001). Three monthly SL-308 injections prolonged median dilation-free survival from 7.8 to 26.4 months (hazard ratio, 0.24; p=0.0003). Conclusions: MAIT-cell IL-17A/F signaling drives subglottic mucosal fibrosis and represents a tractable local therapeutic target.

Background: Primary sclerosing cholangitis lacks approved disease-modifying pharmacotherapies and frequently progresses to biliary cirrhosis or cholangiocarcinoma. Methods: In the phase 2b BILI-FXR14 study across 19 European hepatology centers, 198 patients with large-duct primary sclerosing cholangitis and baseline alkaline phosphatase exceeding 1.5 times the upper limit of normal were randomized 2:1 to the apical sodium-dependent bile acid transporter and fibroblast growth factor-19 dual modulator NGM-812 (6 mg daily, n=132) or placebo (n=66) for 52 weeks. Results: NGM-812 reduced serum alkaline phosphatase by 43.7% versus +4.1% with placebo (p<0.0001), lowered Enhanced Liver Fibrosis scores by 0.68 units (p=0.0011), and decreased pruritus numeric rating scale scores by 3.1 points. Transient grade 2 diarrhea occurred in 14.4% of treated patients. Conclusions: Enterohepatic bile acid pool contraction with NGM-812 improves cholestatic and fibrotic biomarkers in primary sclerosing cholangitis.

Background: Late-onset Pompe disease results from acid alpha-glucosidase deficiency and leads to progressive diaphragmatic and proximal limb weakness despite standard alglucosidase alfa infusions. Methods: We conducted a 78-week randomized double-blind study (POMPE-TF6) comparing an anti-transferrin receptor-1 Fab-conjugated rhGAA fusion protein (TVB-310, 20 mg/kg biweekly, n=76) with cipaglucosidase alfa plus miglustat (n=76) in 152 ambulatory adults across 14 neuromuscular centers. Results: Quadriceps muscle biopsy at week 24 showed a 68.4% reduction in periodic acid-Schiff-positive glycogen content with TVB-310 versus 29.7% with comparator (p<0.0001). At week 78, mean 6-minute walk distance improved by +44.8 meters in the TVB-310 arm compared with +13.2 meters in controls (difference, 31.6 meters; p=0.0005), while upright forced vital capacity increased by +5.9% predicted. Conclusions: Transferrin receptor-1-mediated enzyme transcytosis enhances skeletal muscle glycogen clearance in late-onset Pompe disease.

Background: BK polyomavirus nephropathy causes premature allograft loss in 4% to 8% of kidney transplant recipients following immunosuppressive intensification. Methods: In a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial (ALLO-BKV22) at 11 transplant centers in Germany and Austria, 148 kidney transplant recipients with plasma BK viremia exceeding 10,000 copies/mL received the VP1 pentamer-crosslinking human monoclonal antibody MAb-772 (1500 mg intravenously every 4 weeks for 3 doses, n=74) or placebo (n=74) alongside standardized mycophenolate reduction. Results: Complete plasma viral clearance (<500 copies/mL) at week 16 occurred in 78.4% of MAb-772 recipients versus 36.5% of placebo recipients (p<0.0001). Biopsy-proven polyomavirus nephropathy at 12 months developed in 2.7% versus 18.9% of patients (hazard ratio, 0.13; p=0.0018). Conclusions: Neutralizing VP1 antibody therapy accelerates BK polyomavirus clearance and prevents allograft nephropathy.

Background: Refractory chronic cough affects 3% to 5% of adults and is mediated by vagal C-fiber hyperexcitability in the upper airway mucosa. Methods: In the phase 2b COUGH-TRPM8 crossover trial across eight UK respiratory clinics, 134 adults with refractory chronic cough persisting for a median of 6.4 years received an inhaled selective P2X3/TRPV4 dual antagonist, BLU-449 (50 mg twice daily via dry-powder inhaler), or matched placebo for 6 weeks per period with a 3-week washout. Results: Objective 24-hour ambulatory cough frequency measured by VitaloJAK acoustic monitoring decreased by 64.8% (95% CI, 57.3 to 71.2) during BLU-449 treatment compared with 14.2% during placebo (p<0.0001). Unlike first-generation systemic P2X2/3 antagonists, dysgeusia or hypogeusia was reported by only 2.2% of participants. Conclusions: Inhaled dual P2X3/TRPV4 antagonism suppresses refractory chronic cough without taste disturbance.

Background: Calciphylaxis is a devastating microvascular calcification syndrome in dialysis patients with a 1-year mortality rate approaching 50%. Methods: We conducted a multicenter randomized phase 3 trial (CALCI-PHY11) enrolling 126 hemodialysis patients with ulcerated cutaneous calciphylaxis across 18 US and Canadian renal units to receive intravenous hexasodium phytate replacement analog INS-3011 (10 mg/kg thrice weekly during dialysis, n=63) or sodium thiosulfate standard care (n=63) for 16 weeks. Results: Complete ulcer re-epithelialization at week 16 was achieved in 54.0% of INS-3011 recipients compared with 22.2% of controls (p=0.0003). Mean visual analog pain scores declined by 5.8 versus 2.7 points (p<0.0001), and 26-week all-cause mortality was 14.3% in the INS-3011 group versus 34.9% in controls (hazard ratio, 0.36; p=0.0082). Conclusions: Hydroxyapatite crystal growth inhibition with INS-3011 promotes wound healing and survival in uremic calciphylaxis.

Background: Stargardt macular dystrophy caused by biallelic ABCA4 variants leads to toxic bisretinoid A2E accumulation in retinal pigment epithelium and progressive central blindness. Methods: In the 24-month randomized, double-masked STAR-RBP7 trial across six ophthalmology institutes, 144 adolescents and young adults with molecularly confirmed ABCA4 retinopathy received the oral non-retinoid RBP4 antagonist STG-604 (12 mg daily, n=96) or placebo (n=48). Results: STG-604 lowered serum holo-RBP4 by 79.2% within 14 days and slowed mean fundus autofluorescence definitely decreased autofluorescence lesion growth rate from 0.84 to 0.31 mm2/year (63.1% reduction; p<0.0001). Best-corrected visual acuity loss was 1.8 ETDRS letters in STG-604 recipients versus 6.9 letters in placebo controls (p=0.0019); mild delayed dark adaptation occurred in 19.8% of treated subjects. Conclusions: Oral RBP4 antagonism slows macular atrophy progression in ABCA4-associated Stargardt disease.

Background: Hepatorenal syndrome-acute kidney injury carries high short-term mortality in decompensated cirrhosis, and terlipressin is associated with respiratory failure in volume-overloaded patients. Methods: In the randomized double-blind HRS-APELIN5 trial across 15 Spanish and Italian liver intensive care units, 162 cirrhotic patients with stage 2 or 3 hepatorenal syndrome received continuous infusion of the biased apelin-receptor G-protein agonist MM-202 (0.8 mcg/kg/min) plus low-dose norepinephrine (n=81) or terlipressin plus albumin (n=81) for up to 10 days. Results: Reversal of hepatorenal syndrome (serum creatinine <1.5 mg/dL) occurred in 56.8% of MM-202 recipients versus 44.4% of terlipressin recipients (p=0.11), while hypoxemic respiratory failure occurred in 3.7% versus 17.3% (p=0.0048). Transplant-free survival at day 90 was 64.2% with MM-202 versus 46.9% with terlipressin (p=0.026). Conclusions: Biased apelin-receptor agonism reverses hepatorenal syndrome with lower cardiopulmonary toxicity than terlipressin.

Background: Alopecia areata universalis involves collapse of hair follicle immune privilege mediated by NKG2D+ CD8+ cytotoxic T lymphocytes and interferon-gamma signaling. Methods: We evaluated a subcutaneously administered IL-15 receptor beta (CD122) blocking monoclonal antibody, REX-122 (300 mg every 4 weeks), in a 36-week randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial (SCALP-IL15) involving 156 adults with >90% scalp hair loss for 2 to 10 years. Results: At week 36, a Severity of Alopecia Tool (SALT) score <=20 was achieved by 49.0% of REX-122 recipients (51/104) versus 3.8% of placebo recipients (2/52; p<0.0001). Punch biopsies at week 24 showed an 86.4% depletion of perifollicular CD8+CD103+ resident memory T cells, and 82.4% of responders maintained hair regrowth 24 weeks after treatment cessation. Conclusions: CD122 blockade depletes follicular resident memory T cells and induces durable remission in severe alopecia areata.

Background: Hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia caused by ENG or ACVRL1 haploinsufficiency leads to recurrent severe epistaxis, gastrointestinal arteriovenous malformations, and iron-deficiency anemia. Methods: In the phase 2b HHT-AKT9 study across nine vascular anomaly centers in France and the Netherlands, 118 transfusion- or iron-infusion-dependent patients were randomized 1:1 to the oral allosteric AKT1/2 inhibitor VAD-088 (40 mg once daily) or placebo for 24 weeks. Results: Median weekly epistaxis duration decreased from 142 to 29 minutes in the VAD-088 arm (-79.6%) compared with 138 to 119 minutes in the placebo arm (-13.8%; p<0.0001). Mean hemoglobin rose by +2.8 g/dL with VAD-088 versus +0.2 g/dL with placebo, and parenteral elemental iron requirements fell by 84.1% (p<0.0001). Grade 2 hyperglycemia occurred in 8.5% of treated patients. Conclusions: Allosteric AKT1/2 inhibition reduces vascular malformation bleeding and iron dependence in hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia.

Background: Neurofibromatosis type 1 plexiform neurofibromas often progress or cause dose-limiting acneiform toxicity and cardiomyopathy during chronic MEK1/2 inhibition. Methods: In the multicenter phase 2 NF1-SHP24 trial, 88 pediatric and young adult patients with inoperable symptomatic plexiform neurofibromas refractory to or intolerant of selumetinib received pulsed intermittent dosing of the allosteric SHP2 phosphatase inhibitor RMC-4990 (45 mg/m2 days 1-4 of each 7-day cycle) for 12 four-week cycles. Results: Volumetric MRI analysis demonstrated a partial response (>=20% tumor volume reduction) in 63.6% of patients (56/88), with a median maximal shrinkage of -34.2% (range, -12.1% to -61.8%). Patient-reported NRS-11 tumor pain interference scores improved by a mean of 3.9 points (p<0.0001), and only 4.5% of patients discontinued due to adverse events. Conclusions: Intermittent SHP2 inhibition induces volumetric regression in selumetinib-refractory NF1 plexiform neurofibromas.

Background: Acute graft-versus-host disease affecting the lower gastrointestinal tract remains the leading cause of non-relapse mortality after allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. Methods: In the phase 2b CRYPTO-GVHD trial across 13 transplant centers, 128 patients with steroid-refractory grade III-IV lower intestinal acute GVHD were randomized 1:1 to receive an enterically targeted recombinant human R-spondin-1 mimetic fusion protein, RSP-504 (1.2 mg/kg intravenously twice weekly for 4 weeks, n=64), plus ruxolitinib or ruxolitinib alone (n=64). Results: Day-28 overall response rate was 76.6% in the RSP-504 plus ruxolitinib arm compared with 48.4% in the ruxolitinib monotherapy arm (p=0.0010). Serial sigmoidoscopic biopsies confirmed a 4.2-fold increase in LGR5+OLFM4+ crypt base columnar stem cells and a 69.3% reduction in plasma regenerating islet-derived 3-alpha (REG3A) concentrations. Non-relapse mortality at 6 months was 18.8% versus 40.6% (p=0.0068). Conclusions: Wnt/R-spondin mucosal regeneration combined with JAK1/2 inhibition improves survival in steroid-refractory intestinal GVHD.

Background: Chagas cardiomyopathy caused by persistent myocardial Trypanosoma cruzi infection progresses to ventricular tachycardia and biventricular heart failure despite benznidazole treatment. Methods: In a randomized double-blind phase 2b trial (CHAGAS-PROT17) in Minas Gerais and Cordoba, 210 adults with early chronic Chagas cardiomyopathy (Kuschnir stage I-II) and positive quantitative PCR parasitemia were assigned 1:1 to the selective kinetoplastid proteasome beta-5 subunit inhibitor GSK-3491 (150 mg twice daily for 28 days) or benznidazole (300 mg daily for 60 days). Results: Sustained serial PCR negativity across 6, 12, and 24 months was achieved in 88.6% of GSK-3491 recipients versus 57.1% of benznidazole recipients (p<0.0001). Serum NT-proBNP declined by 41.2% in the GSK-3491 arm versus 9.4% with benznidazole (p=0.0003), and treatment discontinuation for peripheral neuropathy or dermatitis occurred in 1.9% versus 18.1% (p<0.0001). Conclusions: Kinetoplastid proteasome inhibition achieves superior parasitological cure and tolerability in chronic Chagas heart disease.

Background: Autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease is driven by reduced polycystin-1/2 dosage in primary cilia, and vasopressin V2 receptor blockade causes severe aquaresis and idiosyncratic hepatotoxicity. Methods: We evaluated a kidney-targeted folyl-conjugated microRNA-17 antisense oligonucleotide, RGL-882 (2.5 mg/kg subcutaneously every 4 weeks), in a 52-week randomized placebo-controlled phase 2b study (CYST-MIR17) of 174 patients with Mayo class 1C-1E ADPKD across 12 centers. Results: RGL-882 increased urinary exosomal polycystin-1 and polycystin-2 protein levels by 2.4-fold and 2.1-fold at week 24 (both p<0.0001). Height-adjusted total kidney volume grew by +2.1% over 52 weeks in RGL-882 recipients compared with +6.8% in placebo controls (difference, -4.7%; p<0.0001), without polyuria or transaminase elevations above 2 times the upper limit of normal. Conclusions: Monthly miR-17 inhibition restores polycystin expression and slows cyst expansion in high-risk ADPKD.

Background: Eosinophilic esophagitis is characterized by food antigen-driven thymic stromal lymphopoietin release, mast cell infiltration, and subepithelial lamina propria fibrosis. Methods: In the 24-week randomized double-blind EOS-SIGLEC8 trial across 10 US pediatric and adult gastroenterology centers, 138 patients with proton-pump-inhibitor-refractory eosinophilic esophagitis and fibrostenotic rings (EREFS grade >=2) received an oral gut-restricted Siglec-8 agonistic cyclic peptide, AK-094 (100 mg twice daily, n=92), or placebo (n=46). Results: Histologic remission (<6 eosinophils per high-power field) occurred in 72.8% of AK-094 recipients versus 8.7% of placebo controls (p<0.0001), accompanied by an 81.5% depletion of tryptase-positive intraepithelial mast cells. Functional luminal imaging probe panometry showed mean esophageal distensibility plateau increases of +3.4 mm with AK-094 versus +0.4 mm with placebo (p<0.0001). Conclusions: Topical Siglec-8 agonism resolves mucosal eosinophilia, mastocytosis, and fibrostenotic stiffness in eosinophilic esophagitis.

Background: Focal cortical dysplasia type IIb is the most common cause of drug-resistant epilepsy requiring surgical resection in children and results from brain-somatic activating variants in the mTORC1 pathway. Methods: In the multicenter phase 2 FCD-MTOR12 study, 62 children and adolescents (aged 2 to 17 years) with MRI-confirmed focal cortical dysplasia type IIb and >=8 monthly motor seizures received the brain-selective mTORC1 steric inhibitor RAPA-BRN07 (3.5 mg/m2 orally once weekly, sparing mTORC2) in a 16-week double-blind placebo-controlled crossover design. Results: Median 28-day focal motor seizure frequency decreased by 67.4% during RAPA-BRN07 treatment compared with 9.1% during placebo (p<0.0001), and 38.7% of patients achieved complete seizure freedom during the last 8 weeks of active therapy. Stomatitis and hypercholesterolemia occurred in under 5% of participants. Conclusions: brain-selective steric mTORC1 inhibition markedly reduces seizure burden in focal cortical dysplasia type IIb.

Background: Chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension in patients with distal subsegmental disease ineligible for pulmonary endarterectomy carries poor prognosis despite balloon pulmonary angioplasty. Methods: In the randomized double-blind CTEPH-BMPR20 trial across 14 European pulmonary vascular centers, 136 patients with inoperable distal CTEPH and persistent pulmonary vascular resistance >4.5 Wood units after angioplasty received an inhaled liposomal mRNA encoding wild-type BMPR2 (MRT-620, 3.0 mg twice weekly via vibrating-mesh nebulizer, n=68) or nebulized placebo (n=68) for 24 weeks. Results: Right heart catheterization at week 24 showed a mean pulmonary vascular resistance reduction of -3.1 Wood units (-38.2%) in the MRT-620 group compared with -0.3 Wood units in controls (p<0.0001). Mean 6-minute walk distance increased by +58.4 meters versus +6.2 meters (p<0.0001). Conclusions: Inhaled BMPR2 mRNA replacement reverses distal pulmonary microvascular remodeling in inoperable CTEPH.

Background: Geographic atrophy secondary to age-related macular degeneration involves complement activation and NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis of retinal pigment epithelial cells. Methods: In the 18-month phase 2b MACULA-NLRP9 trial across 22 retinal centers, 240 patients with bilateral fovea-sparing geographic atrophy were randomized 1:1:1 to a suprachoroidal microinjector depot of the dual C5aR1/NLRP3 small-molecule inhibitor OCU-714 (4 mg every 6 months, n=80; 2 mg every 6 months, n=80) or sham suprachoroidal injection (n=80). Results: Square-root transformed geographic atrophy lesion growth over 18 months was 0.21 mm in the 4-mg OCU-714 arm and 0.25 mm in the 2-mg arm versus 0.37 mm in sham controls (43.2% and 32.4% reductions; p<0.0001 and p=0.0012). Unlike intravitreal pegcetacoplan, incident macular neovascularization occurred in only 1.3% of OCU-714 eyes versus 1.3% of sham eyes. Conclusions: Twice-yearly suprachoroidal C5aR1/NLRP3 inhibition slows geographic atrophy without inducing neovascular conversion.

Background: Hepatic encephalopathy recurs in up to 40% of cirrhotic patients despite lactulose and rifaximin prophylaxis, driven by gut urease- and glutaminase-producing pathobionts and astrocyte swelling. Methods: In the randomized double-blind AMMON-PHAGE8 trial across 11 North American transplant hepatology centers, 154 patients with a history of >=2 overt hepatic encephalopathy episodes within 6 months received an oral four-bacteriophage cocktail targeting Klebsiella pneumoniae and Proteus mirabilis urease operons plus an engineered ammonia-assimilating Escherichia coli Nissle strain (SYN-NH3, twice daily, n=77) or placebo (n=77) added to lactulose for 24 weeks. Results: Breakthrough overt hepatic encephalopathy (West Haven grade >=2) occurred in 11.7% of SYN-NH3 recipients versus 37.7% of placebo controls (hazard ratio, 0.26; p=0.0002). Fasting venous ammonia decreased by 44.8 umol/L (p<0.0001), and Psychometric Hepatic Encephalopathy Scores improved by +4.1 points. Conclusions: Targeted bacteriophage depletion of urease pathobionts with engineered microbial ammonia scavenging prevents recurrent hepatic encephalopathy.

Background: Hidradenitis suppurativa Hurley stage III forms epithelialized dermal tunnels that harbor B-cell and plasma-cell tertiary lymphoid structures resistant to anti-TNF and anti-IL-17 biologics. Methods: We conducted a 24-week randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2b study (TUNNEL-BAFF16) of a bispecific antibody simultaneously neutralizing BAFF and IL-36R (HSB-402, 600 mg subcutaneously every 2 weeks) in 142 patients with biologic-experienced Hurley stage III hidradenitis suppurativa across 16 centers. Results: Hidradenitis Suppurativa Clinical Response 75 (HiSCR75) at week 24 was achieved by 52.1% of HSB-402 recipients (49/94) compared with 10.4% of placebo controls (5/48; p<0.0001). Draining fistula and tunnel count decreased by a mean of 68.4% versus 14.9% (p<0.0001), and high-frequency Doppler ultrasound showed a 74.2% reduction in dermal tunnel vascularity. Conclusions: Dual BAFF and IL-36R blockade resolves draining dermal tunnels in biologic-refractory severe hidradenitis suppurativa.

Background: Inclusion body myositis is a progressive degenerative myopathy of older adults characterized by cytotoxic KLRG1+ CD8+ T-cell invasion and TDP-43 rimmed vacuole aggregation that is unresponsive to corticosteroids. Methods: In the 72-week randomized double-blind MYO-KLRG19 trial across 12 international neuromuscular centers, 132 patients with clinicopathologically defined inclusion body myositis received an afucosylated anti-KLRG1 depleting monoclonal antibody, UL-288 (10 mg/kg intravenously every 8 weeks, n=66), or placebo (n=66). Results: UL-288 depleted 94.6% of circulating and endomysial CD8+KLRG1+CD57+ T cells without reducing naive or central memory T-cell subsets. At week 72, the Inclusion Body Myositis Functional Rating Scale declined by -0.6 points in the UL-288 group versus -4.4 points in the placebo group (difference, 3.8 points; p<0.0001), and knee extension quantitative myometry stabilized (+1.2% vs -14.8%; p<0.0001). Conclusions: Selective depletion of terminally differentiated KLRG1+ cytotoxic T cells halts functional decline in inclusion body myositis.

Background: Nephropathic cystinosis results from defective lysosomal cystine exporter CTNS, causing Fanconi syndrome, corneal crystal photophobia, and progressive renal allograft and systemic myopathy despite cysteamine therapy. Methods: In the phase 1/2 CYSTIN-HSC10 trial at four European academic centers, 24 adolescents and adults with nephropathic cystinosis underwent autologous transplantation of CD34+ hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells transduced ex vivo with a self-inactivating lentiviral vector encoding human CTNS (LV-CTNS, median vector copy number 2.3 copies/cell) after busulfan conditioning, discontinuing oral cysteamine at day 30. Results: Through 36 months of follow-up, leukocyte cystine levels remained normalized at a mean of 0.34 nmol half-cystine/mg protein (baseline on cysteamine, 1.82; p<0.0001). In vivo confocal microscopy showed a 78.6% reduction in corneal stromal crystal density, and all 16 non-transplanted native kidney patients maintained stable eGFR without cysteamine. Conclusions: Autologous lentiviral CTNS stem-cell gene therapy provides sustained systemic cystine depletion without oral cysteamine.

Background: Osteogenesis imperfecta types III and IV caused by glycine substitutions in the triple-helical domain of COL1A1 or COL1A2 result in severe bone fragility and recurrent long-bone fractures. Methods: In the 52-week randomized phase 3 FRAGILE-TGF11 trial across 15 pediatric metabolic bone centers, 140 children aged 4 to 16 years with severe osteogenesis imperfecta were randomized 1:1 to a bispecific antibody targeting sclerostin and latent TGF-beta-1 activation (OST-905, 8 mg/kg subcutaneously every 4 weeks, n=70) or cyclic intravenous pamidronate (n=70). Results: Lumbar spine areal bone mineral density Z-score increased by +1.94 SD in the OST-905 group versus +0.68 SD in the pamidronate group (p<0.0001). Annualized radiographically confirmed clinical fracture rate was 0.42 fractures/patient-year with OST-905 compared with 1.61 fractures/patient-year with pamidronate (rate ratio, 0.26; 95% CI, 0.16 to 0.42; p<0.0001). Conclusions: Dual sclerostin and TGF-beta-1 inhibition outperforms bisphosphonates in reducing fractures in severe pediatric osteogenesis imperfecta.

Background: Peyronie disease involves transforming growth factor-beta-1 and YAP/TAZ-mediated myofibroblast transdifferentiation within the tunica albuginea, and intralesional collagenase often yields incomplete curvature correction. Methods: In the double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2b TUNICA-YAP6 trial at nine urology centers, 160 men with stable phase Peyronie plaques and penile curvature between 35 and 80 degrees received four biweekly intralesional injections of a lipid-nanoparticle-encapsulated siRNA targeting TEAD1/YAP1 plus recombinant matrix metalloproteinase-1 (LNP-YAP1, 1.5 mg per injection, n=106) or saline placebo (n=54). Results: At week 24, mean penile curvature decreased by -28.4 degrees (-54.6%) in the LNP-YAP1 arm compared with -4.1 degrees (-7.9%) in placebo controls (p<0.0001). Peyronie Disease Questionnaire bother domain scores improved by 6.2 versus 1.3 points (p<0.0001), with no corporeal rupture events. Conclusions: Intralesional YAP/TEAD siRNA with MMP-1 degrades tunical plaques and prevents myofibroblast recurrence in Peyronie disease.

Background: Post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder driven by Epstein-Barr virus reactivation carries high mortality in rituximab-refractory solid organ transplant recipients. Methods: In the multicenter phase 2 EBV-TCR18 trial, 68 solid organ transplant recipients with biopsy-proven rituximab-refractory monomorphic diffuse large B-cell PTLD received off-the-shelf allogeneic HLA-partially matched EBV-specific T cells engineered with a calcineurin-resistant mutant calcineurin-B subunit and a CD30 chimeric costimulatory receptor (ALLO-EBV30, two infusions of 2x10^6 cells/kg 14 days apart) while continuing baseline tacrolimus. Results: Positron emission tomography complete metabolic response rate at week 12 was 69.1% (47/68), with an overall response rate of 83.8%. At 18 months, progression-free survival was 66.2% (95% CI, 53.6 to 76.1), and no cases of allograft rejection or grade >=2 graft-versus-host disease occurred. Conclusions: Calcineurin-resistant CD30-costimulated allogeneic EBV T cells induce durable remissions in rituximab-refractory PTLD without stopping immunosuppression.

Background: Primary ciliary dyskinesia caused by biallelic DNAH5 nonsense mutations leads to absent outer dynein arms, impaired mucociliary clearance, and progressive bronchiectasis. Methods: In the 28-week randomized double-blind CILIA-READ8 trial across eight European and Israeli reference centers, 76 patients with at least one premature termination codon in DNAH5 received nebulized eukaryotic ribosomal selective readthrough modulator ELX-091 (15 mg twice daily via mesh nebulizer, n=51) or placebo (n=25). Results: Nasal brushings at week 12 demonstrated full-length DNAH5 axonemal localization by immunofluorescence in 64.7% of ELX-091 recipients and recovery of coordinated ciliary beat frequency from 0.8 to 9.4 Hz (p<0.0001). Percent predicted FEV1 improved by +6.8% in the ELX-091 group versus -0.9% in placebo controls (difference, 7.7%; p=0.0002), and pulmonary exacerbation rate fell by 58.3%. Conclusions: Nebulized ribosomal readthrough therapy restores ciliary motility and lung function in nonsense-mutant DNAH5 primary ciliary dyskinesia.

Background: Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy caused by JC polyomavirus reactivation in immunocompromised hosts lacks effective direct-acting antivirals. Methods: In the open-label multicenter PML-STING14 trial, 54 patients with cerebrospinal fluid PCR-confirmed progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (32 hematologic malignancy, 14 natalizumab-treated multiple sclerosis, 8 idiopathic CD4 lymphopenia) received an intrathecally and intravenously administered blood-brain-barrier-shuttle anti-JC virus VP1 neutralizing antibody fused to an IL-7 cytokine mutein, JCV-IL7m (25 mg/kg IV every 2 weeks for 12 weeks). Results: Cerebrospinal fluid JC viral load became undetectable (<15 copies/mL) by week 8 in 79.6% of patients (43/54), accompanied by a 4.8-fold expansion of CSF JCV-pentamer-specific CD8+ and CD4+ T cells. Survival at 12 months was 85.2% compared with 38.0% in matched historical controls (hazard ratio, 0.19; p<0.0001), with immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome requiring brief corticosteroids in 14.8%. Conclusions: Bifunctional VP1 neutralization and IL-7 T-cell restoration clears CSF JC virus and improves survival in progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy.

Background: Pseudoxanthoma elasticum results from hepatic ABCC6 deficiency, leading to depressed plasma inorganic pyrophosphate, bruch membrane angioid streaks, and peripheral arterial calcification. Methods: In the 104-week randomized double-blind PXE-ENPP15 trial across seven European reference centers, 108 patients with molecularly confirmed ABCC6 pseudoxanthoma elasticum received subcutaneous Fc-fused recombinant human ENPP1-Albumin enzyme (INZ-709, 1.8 mg/kg once weekly, n=72) or placebo (n=36). Results: INZ-709 normalized trough plasma inorganic pyrophosphate from 0.48 to 1.62 umol/L throughout the 2-year treatment period (p<0.0001). Whole-body low-dose CT arterial calcium volume score in the femoropopliteal bed progressed by +3.4% in INZ-709 recipients versus +27.9% in placebo controls (p<0.0001), and choroidal neovascularization events occurred in 4.2% versus 22.2% of patients (p=0.0061). Conclusions: Weekly ENPP1 enzyme replacement restores systemic pyrophosphate and halts ectopic vascular and retinal mineralization in pseudoxanthoma elasticum.

Background: Radiation-induced xerostomia following intensity-modulated radiotherapy for head and neck squamous cell carcinoma permanently destroys acinar progenitor cells in the parotid and submandibular glands. Methods: In the randomized double-blind phase 2 SALIVA-AQP5 trial across 11 North American oncology centers, 124 patients with severe chronic radiation xerostomia (>=18 months post-radiotherapy, unstimulated whole salivary flow <0.05 mL/min) received bilateral ultrasound-guided intraductal retrojection of an AAV serotype 2/5 vector encoding human aquaporin-1 and SOX9 under a kallikrein promoter (AAV-AQP1/SOX9, 1x10^11 vg/gland, n=82) or sham saline infusion (n=42). Results: At 6 months, mean unstimulated salivary flow increased from 0.03 to 0.24 mL/min in AAV-AQP1/SOX9 recipients versus 0.03 to 0.04 mL/min in sham controls (p<0.0001). Groningen Radiotherapy-Induced Xerostomia questionnaire scores improved by 36.8 points (p<0.0001), with sustained salivary output at 24 months. Conclusions: Intraductal AAV-AQP1/SOX9 gene transfer regenerates fluid secretion in irradiated salivary glands.

Background: Relapsing polychondritis is a rare autoimmune chondritis affecting auricular, nasal, and laryngotracheal cartilage, frequently associated with somatic UBA1 mutations (VEXAS syndrome) or anti-collagen II antibodies. Methods: In the multicenter randomized phase 2 CHONDRO-TL1A trial, 72 patients with glucocorticoid-dependent relapsing polychondritis (excluding VEXAS-positive cases) received a subcutaneously administered bispecific antibody targeting TL1A and IL-23p19, RPC-610 (450 mg every 4 weeks, n=48), or placebo (n=24) during a standardized 16-week prednisone taper to <=5 mg/day. Results: Steroid-free clinical remission (Relapsing Polychondritis Disease Activity Index <=4 on <=5 mg/day prednisone) at week 24 was achieved in 66.7% of RPC-610 recipients versus 16.7% of placebo controls (p<0.0001).
